-- MEEN HUB :: bytecode VM, decode-at-runtime, do not edit by hand
local _O1ll=""
local _1O00=2239131
local _1O1l=30259
local _O10l={}
local _llII={}
do local i,p,plen=0,1,#_O1ll while p<=plen do i=i+1 _O10l[i]=tonumber(_O1ll:sub(p,p+1),36) p=p+2 end end
local OPFN={
  [31]=function(b,k) local r,p,a,c=0,1,b,k while a>0 or c>0 do local ab,cb=a%2,c%2 if ab~=cb then r=r+p end a=(a-ab)/2 c=(c-cb)/2 p=p*2 end return r end,
  [109]=function(b,k) return (b-k+256)%256 end,
  [123]=function(b) return ((b%16)*16)+math.floor(b/16) end,
  [147]=function(b) return 255-b end,
  [239]=function(b,k) k=k%8 if k==0 then return b end local lo=b%(2^k) local hi=math.floor(b/(2^k)) return (lo*(2^(8-k))+hi)%256 end
}
local SEQ={109}
local CN=1
local i,n=1,#_O10l
while i<=n do
  local keys={}
  for c=1,CN do keys[c]=_O10l[i] i=i+1 end
  local val=_O10l[i] i=i+1
  for c=CN,1,-1 do val=OPFN[SEQ[c]](val,keys[c]) end
  _llII[#_llII+1]=string.char(val)
end
local __src=table.concat(_llII)
local __cs=0
for k=1,#__src do __cs=(__cs*131+string.byte(__src,k))%65536 end
if #__src~=_1O00 or __cs~=_1O1l then error("MEEN HUB VM: integrity check failed (len "..#__src.."/".._1O00..", checksum "..__cs.."/".._1O1l..")") end
local __f,__ferr
if load then __f,__ferr=load(__src) end
if not __f and loadstring then __f,__ferr=loadstring(__src) end
if not __f then error("MEEN HUB VM: decoded chunk failed to compile -> "..tostring(__ferr)) end
return __f()
